import argparse
import json

from operation_graph_optimization import algorithm, benchmark

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--pruning", type=int, default=8)
parser.add_argument("--supplier", type=int, default=8)
parser.add_argument("--comparison", type=int, default=64)
arguments, remaining = parser.parse_known_args()
algorithm.MAX_PRUNING_CANDIDATES = arguments.pruning
algorithm.MAX_SUPPLIER_SEARCH_CANDIDATES = arguments.supplier
algorithm.MAX_PAIRWISE_COMPARISON_CANDIDATES = arguments.comparison
print(json.dumps(vars(arguments)), flush=True)
benchmark.main(args=remaining, standalone_mode=False)
